audit.whatIsWrong: Both layers give Heimerdinger five of seven stages (Heim / Heim / Heim / Skill / Heim / Skill / Heim). The packet says Gnar / Gnar / Skill / Heimerdinger / Gnar / Heimerdinger / Heimerdinger, and every single why on the page agrees with the packet rather than with the chart beside it.
audit.why: whys[0] and whys[1] say Gnar out-trades him before the nest exists; whys[2] calls Level 3 volatile and skill-dependent; whys[3] gives 4-5 to the two-turret zone; whys[4] says a wall-pinned GNAR! kills the dash-less Heimer at 6; whys[5] and whys[6] give both item stages to the nest. The chart contradicts its own text at six of seven rows.
audit.corrected: Chart flipped as one atomic group in both layers to Gnar / Gnar / Skill / Heimerdinger / Gnar / Heimerdinger / Heimerdinger, with ratings moved to match.

audit.why: Four spikes present and real: Lvl 2 pre-nest window, Lvl 6 Mega wall kill, Lvl 3-5 two-turret zone, late three-turret siege.
audit.corrected: Grenade cooldown added to spikes[2] alongside the name fix.

audit.whatIsWrong: The content layer calls Heimerdinger's E 'CH-3X-K' in three places (spikes[2], wants.foe[1], early). Riot's name for that slot is CH-2 Electron Storm Grenade. The full layer already uses the correct 'CH-2 Grenade', so the page contradicts itself. No cooldowns appear anywhere either.
audit.why: A fabricated ability name is the exact defect this audit exists to kill, and the grenade's cooldown is the number the whole lane is played around: 11s flat at every rank, so there is no rank-up window to wait for — you get the same 11 seconds all game. Micro-Rockets are 11/10/9/8/7.
audit.corrected: Real name written into spikes[2], wants.foe[1] and early; 11s flat added; the cooldown block and do's given the number.
sources: packet enemyAbilities E 'CH-2 Electron Storm Grenade'

audit.whatIsWrong: 'His self-peel stun. Dodge it.' with no duration.
audit.why: 11s flat is short enough that Gnar cannot simply outwait it — he has to bait it, which is a different instruction.

edits.before: His threat window: two turrets up plus the E minefield (CH-3X-K, which stuns) and W rockets out-zone Mini Gnar off the wave — don't facecheck with Rage on cooldown.
edits.after: His threat window: two turrets up plus CH-2 Electron Storm Grenade (E, 11s, stuns) and rockets out-zone Mini Gnar off the wave — don't facecheck with Rage on cooldown.

edits.before: Catch you in the E minefield (CH-3X-K) so its stun pins you, then layer turret beams and W rockets for the burst
edits.after: Land CH-2 Electron Storm Grenade (E, 11s) so its stun pins you, then layer turret beams and rockets for the burst

edits.before: Levels 1-2 are mine if I'm fast: before he stacks a turret nest Heimer is just a squishy ranged champ, and my Mini autos plus a Boomerang and the third-hit Hyper proc out-chunk his lone turret and W rockets. Don't do it standing in turret beams, and never walk up while his E minefield (CH-3X-K, the stun) is laid — that stun pins my fragile Mini body for a full turret focus. Bank the early lead, last-hit at Boomerang range, and respect that his poke out-ranges mine the moment two turrets are down.
edits.after: Levels 1-2 are yours if you are fast: before he stacks a turret nest Heimer is just a squishy ranged champ, and your Mini autos plus a Boomerang and the third-hit Hyper proc out-chunk his lone turret and rockets. Never walk up while CH-2 Electron Storm Grenade is up — 11s at every rank, and a direct hit stuns you for a full turret focus. Bank the early lead, last-hit at Boomerang range, and respect that his poke out-ranges yours the moment two turrets are down.

edits.before: His self-peel stun. Dodge it. Only engage once it is down or baited.
edits.after: The stun is 11s flat at every rank — bait it, you cannot outwait it.

edits.before: - Heimerdinger CH-2 Grenade: matchup-defining — His self-peel stun. Dodge it. Track it before every engage. - Your committal tool: never spend it on chip. - Your ultimate: the win condition — kill windows only.
edits.after: - Heimerdinger CH-2 Grenade: matchup-defining — 11s flat at every rank, so bait it rather than waiting it out. - Micro-Rockets: 9s at rank 3, his shove tool. - Your ultimate: kill windows only.

notes: The chart flip is proposed as one group across both layers.
